claims.quote: An unlocked-to-locked transition on the early `acCtx.Err() != nil` return leaves the state at IDLE.
claims.notes: Graded with c4 (the scenario in the item's consequence). The item's own example is that acCtx is cancelled by another updateAddrs or tearDown before the goroutine runs. With the lock now handed from updateAddrs/connect into resetTransportAndUnlock, neither can run in between: both need ac.mu, and ac.ctx is read under the lock. ac.ctx is only cancelled by tearDown (which sets Shutdown first, so connect returns early) or by updateAddrs (which immediately installs a fresh ctx), or by cc.ctx cancellation when the whole channel is closing. So the stuck-IDLE example is disproved; it was possible before the change, not after.
evidence: clone/clientconn.go:905-923 connect checks Shutdown/non-Idle under lock, then calls resetTransportAndUnlock without releasing
